channel.title: South Coast Business Awards 2018 - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from South Coast Business Awards 2018 (dailyecho.co.uk)

item.title: Tributes paid to ‘true gentleman’ and coastwatch founding member
item.description: Tributes have been paid to a “true gentleman” and friend who dedicated years of service to the RNLI and Coastwatch.

item.title: Families make emotional plea to prevent 'unspeakable horrors' at funeral directors
item.description: Dame Caroline Dinenage MP and bereaved families have called for regulation of the funeral industry after the 'most shocking' case in Gosport.

item.title: Southampton restaurant where ‘every course is excellent’ deserves Michelin Guide spot
item.description: Daily Echo readers have shared a few restaurants they want to see in the Michelin Guide, including Soleto and Gurkha Lounge in Southampton

item.title: Historic retail building for sale in busy Hampshire market town
item.description: A historic retail building is on sale for just under £1 million in Romsey, a busy Hampshire market town.

item.title: Man sentenced for spree of 11 thefts including £1k from Waitrose
item.description: A man has been sentenced after stealing £1,000 in goods from Waitrose in Fareham

item.title: Golf course plans to permanently close holes in favour of driving range
item.description: Plans to close three golf holes and build a new driving range facility at East Horton Golf Centre have been submitted.

item.title: Boy, 9, wears Saints kit to Fratton Park event to 'annoy' Pompey fans
item.description: A nine-year-old boy from Southsea has become an internet sensation after turning up to World Book Day at Fratton Park dressed in a Southampton football kit.

item.title: Residents fear 'someone will be killed' on road with controversial traffic measures
item.description: Car crashes, burst tyres and potholes are just some of the claims made by residents living on a road where the council installed controversial buildouts in Bassett.

item.title: Around 90,000 homes to receive details on change to New Forest parking charges
item.description: Information explaining controversial plans to introduce parking charges across the New Forest are set to be delivered to 90,000 households in the region.

item.title: Son 'lost control' and assaulted his 'sexual predator' dad after 'years of trauma'
item.description: A Southampton man has spoken out after beating up his "sexual predator" dad following "years of trauma" caused by his offending.
